The '''Ter40 high-output ion turbine''' was a model of [[high-output ion turbine]] manufactured by [[Girodyne/Legends|Girodyne]] and sold for 5300 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]. It was available in the period following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]].
